items.title: Trump’s Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy Announces Milestone in Air Traffic Control Overhaul with Deployment of Surface Safety Technology

Duffy today announced that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) installed the 100th Surface Awareness Initiative (SAI) —an aircraft and vehicle surveillance tool—reaching nearly half of the 220 airports set to receive the system.
